answer: Random beacon spot-checks plus heartbeats block bulk fakes. Each stakes 200 credits for one key, unique as a dune grain. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% at random; each must solve a puzzle in 10 minutes. Three misses slash the stake and suspend it 20 epochs. Making 1,000 fakes costs 200,000 credits, but each earns 30, so attacks lose money. An honest agent pays once, like one jade token. A quartz timer stamps its reply, keeping rewards undiluted.
